subject: Quota safety net: steward assignments & shortfall remediation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quota safety net: steward assignments & shortfall remediation

Team —

We ran the numbers during finance prep and Acme is showing a ~22% shortfall against their committed close plan for Q4. Finance asked for a concrete stewarding plan that (a) assigns ownership for the at-risk deals, (b) defines the mitigation actions and expected incremental ARR by week, and (c) lists the minimal asks from Finance (credits, extended payment terms, or SLA commitments).

Attached is a first-pass pipeline_readiness_sheet_v3.xlsx with a suggested steward per deal and a very conservative rollforward. Can each of you take the steward column for your accounts and confirm: owner + 1st mitigation action + expected delta by 10/10?

Quick asks:
- Neha: prioritize the three deals flagged as "high-prob but stalling" (rows 12/19/23).
- Lauren: confirm finance-friendly mitigation language for any proposed credits (I added short note in column H).
- Karthik: I noted two stage reclassifications (MQL->SQL) that might change coverage calculations; please confirm.

Plan to sync 11:30 PT. If you can't make it, reply with your updates in the sheet.

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, MidMarket Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_readiness_sheet_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), safety-net-stewards-roles.pdf (one-page role matrix)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quota safety net: steward assignments & shortfall remediation

Marcus —

I reviewed rows 12/19/23. Quick notes:
- Row 12 (Acme: Cloud Migration): I'm taking point. Mitigation = extend a 6-week PoC with fixed milestones + $25k one-time onboarding credit if they sign by EOW. Expected delta: $150k new ARR by conservatively pushing to Jan close.
- Row 19 (Bluegate): I recommend an interim demo to the platform team and accelerate the technical reference call — owner: me, first action: schedule demo by 10/07. Expected conservative delta: $90k.
- Row 23 (Northstar): staging issue — Sales Ops needs to clear an open procurement blocker. I'm asking Anna at Acme Ops to confirm procurement timeline (cc'd below).

I've updated the sheet and added short rationale in column I.

Neha
Sr. Account Exec

On procurement: Anna (Acme) — can you confirm the expected PO timing?

Attachments referenced: deal_rollforward_10-03.csv (export of influenced ARR by steward)

From: Anna Ruiz <anna.ruiz@acmeenterprise.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeenterprise.com>, maya@acmeenterprise.com
Date: 2026-10-03T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quota safety net: steward assignments & shortfall remediation

Hi Neha / Marcus —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. For Northstar we have two pending items: final security attestation and an internal pricing approval (finance gate). Security has indicated we can clear the attestation by 10/09 if Redwood provides the updated SOC excerpt (I flagged the SOC request to your security team earlier this week). Pricing approval is on our side — CFO wants a one-page summary of net run-rate impact.

I'm copying Daniel (CFO) to keep finance in the loop. I can aim to expedite PO if the two blockers are closed this week.

— Anna
Head of Sales Ops, Acme Enterprise

Forwarded attachment: Acme_req_list.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quota safety net: steward assignments & shortfall remediation

Good updates — thanks everyone. Summary / next steps:

1) Owners confirmed: Neha taking Cloud Migration (row 12), Lauren take Northstar (row 23) to lead the finance ask doc, Karthik will finalize stage reclassification decisions (impact on coverage).
2) Action deadlines: owners to update the shared sheet with concrete week-by-week deltas by COB 10/06.
3) Lauren: please draft the 1-page net run-rate summary for Acme CFO and drop to the related links folder (I put a stub drive link in metadata). Finance has asked we include an explicit "residual risk" column if we propose any credits.
4) If the combined mitigations only recover <60% of the delta by 10/20, we'll prep an ask for a small-term bridging credit (finance to sign off).

I'll lead the 11:30 sync and bring a two-slide summary for exec review. If anything material changes before then, reply-all with the updated row and the estimated delta.

Marcus
VP, MidMarket Sales
Redwood Inference
